Tenant Sub Cloud Resource Get All Sub Clouds
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/subclouds

Retrieves all the subclouds and the excluded data centers that are associated with the subcloud

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Page size

Default value: 100
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier for the subcloud

name
string

Subcloud name

dcs
object[]
exclusions
object[]
]
